correctness.rationale: Verified the polynomial lifts to bijections by f(x+2^t)-f(x)≡2^t (mod 2^(t+1)); exact iteration doubling lemma uses Taylor G^2(x)-x=Delta(1+G'(x))+O(Delta^2) with v2(Delta)>=2 and G'≡1 (mod4). Positive shells begin at exact displacement 1+ds and double valuation every power-of-two iterate. Odd shells start with a two-step displacement of valuation 2 for even d and 3 for odd d, then double. Orbit lengths follow from these valuations, and count-versus-ball-cardinality proves every asserted ball is minimal; nonzero points cannot be periodic in Z_2 because f(x)=x iff x=0. Independent exhaustive finite permutation tracing for d=3..11 and k=1..11 passed; infinite case follows the algebra, not finite tracing.
residual_risks: Only coefficient 2 and d>=3; general odd multiples 2a and degree 2 not claimed.
